error.$comment:
A known failure state the platform reports deliberately, as against a break nobody chose. `app_errors` reads both facets in every store, so both are declared in every store.

`code` is @yaks/tools' half of this word: what a refused call says about itself, written by the runner rather than stamped by the platform. One word, both meanings, so a store never has to choose.

blob.$comment: The two rows a page's upload makes (./uploads.ts): the content, addressed by its sha, and the use of it, addressed off that. They stay apart because they are two things, and because a component may not point at its own entity.

source.$comment: The web address the file was fetched from (library-tools.ts).

document_page.description: Text extracted from one stored document page; searchable by words and meaning.
document_page.$comment: Removing an upload's content row retains both the row in graph trash and its bytes for recovery. A permanent purge needs its owner's choice.

document_text.description: Completed extraction of an attachment’s immutable bytes.

document_extract.description: Extract stored documents once into searchable pages, reading scanned pages too.

hearing.description: An upload asked to be heard through ./api/speech/hear.
hearing.$comment: A recording the app keeps, heard whole (hearings.ts): the speech door asks with `hearing` on the upload's own entity, the one its `attachment` is on, and the store's effect hears it and writes each turn, then `heard`, or `failed` with why. Only the door asks, so only whoever may ask the app's models spends its space's budget on it.

heard.description: An upload heard whole: its seconds, its turns and whether they tell speakers apart.

heard_turn.description: What one speaker said in a heard upload, and its seconds in the recording.

recording.$comment: Not stamped, so deleting the upload deletes its turns: a cascade never follows a stamped reference (@yaks/vocab `deaths`).

speech_hear.description: Hear an upload whole once asked, writing each turn and charging its minutes.

delete_upload.description: tell the platform an upload is no longer served, retaining its bytes in trash
delete_upload.$comment: An upload's content row gone (its `blob`, or a model's `artifact`): no row names its bytes any more, so its address stops answering. The bytes stay, for recovery from trash.

decision_ask.description: ask or close the app’s decision in its person’s Updates, through the space’s Operator
decision_ask.$comment: A decision written here, by a workflow's step or the app's code, is asked in its person's Updates, and their answer comes back on it as `decided{choice}` (workers/yak app-decisions.ts).

notify_deaths.description: tell the space’s other apps an entity here died, so their references to it follow their death rules
notify_deaths.$comment: Every entity here carries `created`, so its removal is the entity's death (deaths.ts).
